scope: Repair only the shared portable doctor static-ELF classifier and its regression tests; no registry, tool payload, MCP, SDK, CLI interface, or unrelated native solver changes.

findings.P1: ft_has_elf_magic was called but not defined; add a bounded four-byte ELF magic reader and fail closed when the header is absent.
findings.P2: An ET_EXEC with e_entry=0 and an executable file-backed PT_LOAD beginning at zero could be treated as a static candidate; require a nonzero entry and add an explicit zero-entry fixture.

problem.review_finding: P1: absence of PT_INTERP alone is not proof of static linkage. An ET_DYN shared object may contain PT_DYNAMIC and DT_NEEDED without PT_INTERP; skipping ldd can hide missing dependencies.
problem.false_positive: ET_DYN + no PT_INTERP + PT_DYNAMIC + DT_NEEDED was accepted as static ELF OK.
problem.related_guard: ET_REL/ET_CORE and malformed/unsupported ELF must never be accepted as static.

classifier.static_shortcut: Only ELF64 little-endian EM_X86_64 ET_EXEC with PT_LOAD carrying PF_X and a file-backed p_vaddr..p_vaddr+p_filesz range containing e_entry, nonzero, and neither PT_INTERP nor PT_DYNAMIC is accepted as static.
classifier.dynamic_or_ambiguous: PT_INTERP, ET_DYN, PT_DYNAMIC, foreign machine/class, non-executable load segments, entry outside executable file-backed PT_LOAD, or unrecognized/unsupported ELF does not receive a static verdict; it uses the normal fail-closed ldd path.
classifier.dynamic_table: For PT_DYNAMIC, parse the bounded p_offset/p_filesz region using ELF32/ELF64 entry sizes, require DT_NULL termination, and detect DT_NEEDED. Any DT_NEEDED routes to ldd; malformed, unterminated, or dependency-free PT_DYNAMIC remains ambiguous and also routes to ldd.
classifier.bounds: Validate ELF header, program-header and dynamic-table ranges against file size; validate PT_LOAD p_offset+p_filesz and p_vaddr+p_filesz without signed overflow; require p_filesz <= p_memsz; cap program headers at 4096 and dynamic entries at 65536; reject duplicate PT_DYNAMIC and malformed tables.

regressions.et_rel: A crafted ET_REL image with PT_LOAD but no executable entry must not take the static shortcut.
regressions.missing_needed: Compile a real ET_DYN shared object with -shared -fPIC and DT_NEEDED for a private library; verify readelf reports Type DYN, PT_DYNAMIC present, PT_INTERP absent, and DT_NEEDED present; remove the library; real host ldd must cause doctor FAIL.
regressions.static_positive: Preserve the existing real gcc -static executable positive.
regressions.dynamic_positive: Preserve the existing real GCC dynamic PIE positive.
regressions.existing_controls: Preserve the previous GNU/musl dependency listing, missing-library, malformed diagnostic, vDSO-only, static marker, doctor argument, and private-library containment controls.
regressions.wrong_machine: An ELF64-LE ET_EXEC with e_machine=EM_AARCH64 on the x86_64 bundle host must not take the static shortcut.
regressions.non_executable_load: An ET_EXEC whose PT_LOAD lacks PF_X must not take the static shortcut.
regressions.entry_outside_load: An ET_EXEC whose e_entry is outside every executable file-backed PT_LOAD must not take the static shortcut.
regressions.zero_entry: An ELF64-LE x86_64 ET_EXEC with e_entry=0 and PF_X PT_LOAD starting at virtual address 0 (so the entry is otherwise inside the file-backed range) must not use the static shortcut and must follow fail-closed ldd.

local_probe.runtime: Node.js 22.16.0 for shell-level parser reproduction only
local_probe.scope: Local ELF parser reproduction; not a substitute for the exact-head Node24 CI.
local_probe.wrong_machine_et_exec: REWORK_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REPRODUCED on prior code; fixed path must return unsupported and delegate to fail-closed ldd.
local_probe.non_executable_load: REWORK_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REPRODUCED on prior code; fixed path must return unsupported and delegate to fail-closed ldd.
local_probe.entry_outside_load: New regression added; exact local return to be captured.
